flags.message: The 20-page application is marked empty_text=true and ocr_derived=false; application.txt contains only whitespace. Opening its provisioned PDF URL returned no usable content. The grounds, requested scope, challenged order, and asserted harm could not be assessed; the forecast is record-limited rather than an assessment of the unread filing.

For application Term 2026, metrics/statpack.json's required 2016–2025 pool has finer_granted=0, finer_resolved=0, finer_unread=1366. It supplies no eligible finer-reading baseline despite the markdown's older substantive rates. No older-reading, current-Term, or cert rate was substituted.

The snapshot filename and context cutoff are 2026-10-21, but its header says docketed October 30, 2026. The sole submission entry is October 20 and matches the event opening. Used that entry and frozen context as the starting state; did not infer subsequent judicial inaction from the header chronology.
